accessibility:
- The container renders as a semantic `<div>` by default.
- Use semantic HTML and accessible children within the container for best practices.
summary: The `Container` component provides a responsive and flexible layout wrapper for your Bulma React UI.

parts.summary: The `Container` component provides a responsive and flexible layout wrapper for your Bulma React UI.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color alias: renders `has-text-<color>`, exactly like `textColor`. Not a filled variant (no `.container.is-<color>` CSS exists). Prefer `textColor`, which takes precedence when both are set; use `bgColor` for a colored surface.

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color helper. `scheme-*` values render as a dark-mode-safe inline `background-color: var(--bulma-scheme-*)` instead of a class. The `scheme-invert*` values do not change text color — pair them with a contrasting foreground.

props.name: fluid
props.description: Makes the container full-width with a 32px gap on each side.

props.name: widescreen
props.description: Makes the container full-width until the `widescreen` breakpoint.

props.name: fullhd
props.description: Makes the container full-width until the `fullhd` breakpoint.

props.name: isMax
props.description: Uses Bulma's `is-max-*` class for the specified breakpoint, limiting max width.
